Days.title: Days
Days.description: Number of days from the user's request. For example, pass 5 for 'created in last 5 days'. Leave blank for 'created recently' so the action defaults to 7 days.

AccountName.title: Account Name
AccountName.description: Optional account name filter if the user asks for recently created Opportunities for a specific account.

StageName.title: Stage Name
StageName.description: Optional Opportunity stage filter if the user asks for recently created Opportunities in a specific stage.

OwnerName.title: Owner Name
OwnerName.description: Optional Opportunity owner name filter if the user asks for recently created Opportunities owned by a specific person.
